annotations.text:
The C/V/S/E chips are the whole thesis in one control.

Green = the provider publishes it.
Outline = missing, so sparqlwatch serves it instead.

That makes the facet rail read as "what needs fixing", not "who scores badly".

Deliberately no single 0-100 score anywhere.

Scores are computed from stored measurements, so any weighting we publish is one view among several. Showing four concrete gaps is more actionable than one number, and avoids the umakadata trap of baking a formula into the schema.

"Not measurable: 2 endpoints" is a first-class tile, not an error state.

QLever's osm-planet ran a metadata query for 24 minutes without returning. Reporting 0 triples there would be a lie; this is the honest version.

Series colours are re-stepped from ontoexplorer's, not copied.

Its dark accents sit above the recommended lightness band, and in light mode its blue and purple are only deltaE 13 apart even for normal vision. Both now pass all-pairs CVD checks.
